marta: Quick triage from the Corsair adapter bring-up. Ran the 20-invoice quickpack + an extended 50-sample invoice set against three artifacts: base(redwood/xl-7b fp16), corsair-lora-v2 merged fp16, and two quant targets (int8, int4 blockwise). High-level: int8 looks within tolerance, int4 shows a recurring currency-format and small-decimal drop in ~6-9% of invoice cases on the extended set.
lee: thanks. can you paste the aggregated metrics and any spot examples?
marta: paste below. kept the quickpack concise. halluc = numeric hallucination heuristic (missing decimals, wrong currency), fmt_diff = formatting differences vs canonical.

```
model                           EM    F1    halluc    fmt_diff    mean_embed_delta
redwood/xl-7b_fp16 (base)       86%   91%   1.8%      2/200       0.0000
corsair-lora-v2_fp16             87%   92%   1.6%      1/200       0.0011
corsair-lora-v2_int8             86%   91%   2.0%      3/200       0.0042
corsair-lora-v2_int4             81%   87%   6.5%     12/200       0.0298
```

marta: example failure: prompt expects "$1,234.56"; int4 outputs "1234 dollars 56 cents" OR drops the ".56" entirely in two cases.
noah: tokenization check? corsair added invoice prefixes like `INV:` and `AMT:` right?
sophia: yep - those special prefixes are sensitive to embedding geometry. did you compute L2 shifts for those tokens?
marta: yes: int8 preserves geometry (mean delta ~0.004), int4 shows increased delta (~0.03) concentrated on numeric-related tokens. also saw slight KV cache mismatch for streaming path (first-chunk decode difference).
ops-bot: kernel note from logs: `runtime-gpu-quant-v2 -> quant-kernel-blockwise4 (group=128)` produced 3 fallbacks to cpu for streaming requests (trace ids: r-44a, r-44b, r-55c).
lee: interesting. could be group-size vs pad alignment edge-case. what was the quant pipeline?
marta: we followed merge-then-quant: merge LoRA into fp16 checkpoint, clip tiny weights, run blockwise quantize with 1024 calibration samples. snippet: 
``ncommit: b7c9d2f
merge: tools/merge_lora --base redwood/xl-7b --lora corsair-lora-v2 --out /tmp/merged/corsair-v2
clip: python tools/clip_small_weights.py /tmp/merged/corsair-v2 --thresh 1e-4
quant: python tools/quantize.py --model /tmp/merged/corsair-v2 --bits 4 --group 128 --calib 1024 --method blockwise
```

noah: two angles to try: 1) quantize base first then graft adapter (apply LoRA on top of quant base) and 2) post-quant per-token bias correction for numeric tokens. both have worked before for token-preserving finetunes.
sophia: I'll prototype a per-token bias map approach. idea: compute embedding delta for each special token (pre/post quant) and apply a tiny additive bias on the token logits during decode to nudge outputs back. quick patch script: `tools/post_quant_bias.py --model quant4 --bias-map bias.json --out corrected/`
marta: can you estimate how many tokens to include? we flagged 18 tokens as high-delta, but numeric space is long.
sophia: start with 30 tokens: `INV:, AMT:, $, ., 0..9, comma` + tokenized currency words. we'll see if that reduces fmt_diff without hurting general fluency.
lee: also try alternate quant params: group=64 and calibration=2048; smaller groups sometimes keep local geometry better.
marta: will run 3 variants tonight: (A) base-quant-first then apply LoRA (B) merge-then-quant with group=64/calib=2048 (C) merge-then-quant + post-quant bias map from sophia prototype.
qa-bot: quickpack expanded run queued. threshold for canary block: halluc_rate > 3.5% OR fmt_diff > 8/200. current int4 baseline = 12/200 fmt_diff on extended set -> block candidate.
deploy-bot: Canary promotion blocked for `corsair-lora-v2_int4`. See tag:blocked.
noah: I'll add 50 more invoice variants including edge decimals (0.00, .5, negative amounts) to stress test.
marta: reproduction steps for anyone: 
``n# reproduce locally
git checkout b7c9d2f
python tools/run_quickpack.py --model /tmp/merged/corsair-v2 --prompts ./evals/corsair-invoice-20.json --out quickruns/1745612345
```

lee: nice. let's sync tomorrow AM. sophia, ETA for bias prototype?
sophia: aiming EOD + tests. will post bias.json and a small before/after diff.
marta: thanks. if bias fix fails we'll revert int4 canary and iterate on group/calib. ops-bot: FYI filed infra ticket INF-4021 to look at the three GPU fallback traces.
lee: perfect. tagging @deploy-bot again: hold promotions until this thread clears. :no_entry:
deploy-bot: confirmed. promotion remains blocked for corsair int4. :white_check_mark: pending follow-up.
marta: thanks team — reconvene after the three pipeline runs + sophia's bias patch. :rocket:
